title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Genesis 14: the war of the kings, Abram's rescue of Lot and his meeting with Melchizedek.

questions.text: Of which land was Chedorlaomer king?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 lists Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim.

questions.text: For how many years had the kings served Chedorlaomer before they rebelled?
questions.explanation: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

questions.text: What was the valley of Siddim full of?
questions.explanation: The valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there.

questions.text: Whom did the invading kings take captive from Sodom, along with his goods?
questions.explanation: They took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

questions.text: How many trained men, born in his house, did Abram lead out?
questions.explanation: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men and pursued as far as Dan.

questions.text: Where is Hobah, the place to which Abram pursued the enemy?
questions.explanation: Abram struck them by night and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

answers.text: On the shore of the Salt Sea
On the left hand of Damascus
On the east side of Bethel

questions.text: What did Melchizedek king of Salem bring out?
questions.explanation: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

questions.text: What did Abram give after Melchizedek blessed him?
questions.explanation: Melchizedek blessed Abram and blessed God Most High, and Abram gave him a tenth of all.

questions.text: What did the king of Sodom ask Abram to give him?
questions.explanation: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself."

questions.text: Why did Abram refuse to take anything that belonged to the king of Sodom?
questions.explanation: Abram said he would not take a thread nor a sandal strap, lest the king should say, "I have made Abram rich."

answers.text: So the king could not say he had made Abram rich
Because Melchizedek had told him to
Because he already had too much livestock
